# Canonical fingerprint of the awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml LICENSE file.
# Source: https://github.com/awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml (LICENSE, branch main)
# Captured: 2026-05-23 at sha=1540f226ffdd2ea0e188173c51b2c0392340dace.
# This file is the baseline that scripts/monitor_aws_health.sh diffs against.
# If the upstream LICENSE changes away from CC-BY-ND (NoDerivatives), the
# monitor fails, a watchdog issue is opened, and a license re-audit is owed
# before the next AWS icon refresh — because the verbatim-only redistribution
# regime in this repo depends on the NoDerivatives clause being unchanged.
#
# The monitor asserts BOTH the load-bearing license marker line AND the
# sha256 of the whole LICENSE file. The marker survives whitespace reflow;
# the sha catches any substantive edit.
